items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Quincy led one band, and Cannonball [Adderley] played with my band.

ctx.x: Sammy Davis, Jr. So I got a chance to watch Quincy – what he did, how he led the band. And that’s why I had recommended Quincy when they put together the big festival where they had college bands. Quincy led one band, and Cannonball [Adderley] played with my band. Fact is, I remember that we did Roly Poly with him.
Which is one of my favorite of your tunes.
